templates.title: 初次询盘回复
templates.scenario: 客户通过阿里/官网/展会主动询价，说对你们的幼儿园家具感兴趣。
templates.subject: Re: Inquiry about Kindergarten Furniture — [Your Company]
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for your inquiry about our kindergarten furniture! This is [Your Name] from [Company Name], a professional kindergarten furniture and playground equipment manufacturer with [X] years' experience.

To give you the most accurate quotation, could you share a few details:
1. What specific products are you interested in? (classroom furniture / outdoor playground / functional rooms)
2. What is your target quantity or project size?
3. Which trade term do you prefer? (FOB / CIF / EXW)
4. What is your destination port?

Meanwhile, I have attached our product catalog for your reference. We specialize in solid wood kindergarten furniture (Mongolian Scotch pine) and custom outdoor playground structures.

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Company Name]
[Contact Info]
templates.cn: 客户主动询价时，先感谢+自我介绍，然后用4个问题引导客户提供详细信息，同时附产品目录。不要一上来就报价，因为信息不足报不准。
templates.tips: 24小时内回复是黄金时间！回复越快，成交概率越高。问题不要超过5个，否则客户嫌烦。

templates.title: 模糊询盘引导需求
templates.scenario: 客户只说'I want kindergarten furniture'或'send me your price list'，没有具体需求。
templates.subject: Re: Kindergarten Furniture Inquiry — Let me help you find the right products
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for reaching out! I would be happy to help you with kindergarten furniture.

We have a wide range of products, so to recommend the most suitable items for you, could you tell me:

1. Are you furnishing a new kindergarten or adding items to an existing one?
2. How many classrooms do you have, and what is the age range of the children? (0-3 / 3-6)
3. Do you have a budget range for this project?
4. Are you more interested in indoor furniture (tables, chairs, beds, storage) or outdoor playground equipment (slides, climbing frames)?

If you have a floor plan or photos of your space, that would be even better — we can provide a customized layout proposal.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 模糊询盘不要直接发价格表（产品太多，客户看不过来）。用4个问题筛选需求：新园还是添置、班级数和年龄、预算、室内还是户外。如果有平面图，可以做定制布局方案——这是教玩具外贸的核心竞争力。
templates.tips: 模糊询盘的客户往往是新手或还在规划阶段，要有耐心引导。提到'customized layout proposal'（定制布局方案）能体现你的专业度，比只会发目录的同行强。

templates.title: 报价单发送（PI）
templates.scenario: 客户需求明确后，发送形式发票PI。
templates.subject: Quotation for [Product/Project Name] — PI No. [Number]
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for the detailed information. Please find attached our Proforma Invoice (PI No. [Number]) for your review.

Here is a summary:
- Products: [Product names and quantities]
- Total Amount: USD [Amount] ([Trade Term] [Port])
- Payment Terms: [e.g. 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment]
- Lead Time: [e.g. 25-30 working days after deposit]
- Validity: This quotation is valid for 15 days.

A few notes:
- The price is based on our standard specifications. Custom colors or sizes may affect the price.
- For outdoor playground equipment, we recommend EPDM safety surfacing (not included in this PI) — we can add it if you need.
- If your order quantity increases, we can offer a better unit price.

Please let me know if you have any questions. Once you confirm the PI and arrange the deposit, we will start production immediately.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 发PI时要在邮件正文里做摘要（产品、总价、付款方式、交期、有效期），不要只甩一个附件。同时加2-3个注意事项（定制可能加价、EPDM地垫不含、量大可优惠），体现专业。最后明确下一步：确认PI+付定金=开始生产。
templates.tips: PI一定要写有效期（通常15-30天），因为原材料价格和海运费会波动。教玩具的交期要写'working days after deposit'（定金后工作日），不要写自然日。

templates.title: MOQ说明
templates.scenario: 客户问最小起订量，或者客户要的数量低于MOQ。
templates.subject: Re: MOQ for Kindergarten Furniture
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for your question about MOQ.

For our standard kindergarten furniture (tables, chairs, beds, cabinets), the MOQ is [e.g. 50 pieces per model]. However, we understand that every project is different, so here are some options:

1. **Mixed container**: You can mix different products from our catalog to fill one container (20GP or 40HQ). This is the most cost-effective option.
2. **Small order surcharge**: If your quantity is below MOQ, we can still accept it with a small order surcharge of [e.g. USD 150] to cover setup costs.
3. **Sample order**: If you just want to test the quality first, we can send samples (sample fee + express cost), which can be refunded on your first bulk order.

For custom outdoor playground equipment, there is no fixed MOQ — each project is custom-designed based on your site size. The minimum investment is typically around USD [e.g. 5,000] for a small unit.

Could you tell me what products and quantities you have in mind? I can check the best option for you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 客户问MOQ时，不要只说一个数字就完了。给3个选项：拼柜（最划算）、小单加费、样品单（可退）。户外定制设备没有固定MOQ，按场地设计，最小投资约5000美金。最后反问客户具体要什么，帮他选最优方案。
templates.tips: 教玩具行业拼柜（mixed container）很常见，因为一个幼儿园需要多种产品。强调拼柜可以降低客户的采购门槛。样品费可退（refundable on first bulk order）是促进客户下单的好策略。

templates.title: 样品请求回复
templates.subject: Re: Sample Request for [Product Name]
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for your interest in our [Product Name]. We would be happy to send you a sample for quality evaluation.

Here are the sample details:
- Sample: [Product name and specification]
- Sample Fee: USD [Amount] (refundable on your first bulk order over USD [Amount])
- Express Cost: USD [Amount] (via DHL/FedEx, 5-7 working days)
- Total: USD [Amount]

If you would like to proceed, please send your delivery address and we will send you a PayPal invoice for the sample fee.

Alternatively, if you have a courier account (DHL/FedEx/UPS), we can ship on your account and you only pay the sample fee.

Once you receive and approve the sample, we can move forward with the bulk order quotation.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 客户要样品时，明确列出：样品费（可退）、快递费、总计。给两个付款选项：PayPal付样品费+我们付快递，或者客户有快递账号到付。最后说样品确认后可以推进大单。
templates.tips: 样品费一定要收！免费样品客户不珍惜，而且教玩具有些样品（如桌椅）体积大、运费贵。样品费可退是行业惯例，能降低客户顾虑。快递费要按实际重量和体积重（volumetric weight）算，教玩具通常体积重>实际重。

templates.title: 付款方式说明
templates.scenario: 客户问付款方式，或者客户要求的付款方式我们不接受（如D/A、O/A）。
templates.subject: Re: Payment Terms
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for asking about our payment terms. Here is what we offer:

**Standard terms (for most orders):**
- 30% T/T deposit in advance (to confirm the order and start production)
- 70% T/T balance before shipment (after production is complete and we send you photos/videos)

**For large projects (over USD 50,000):**
- Irrevocable L/C at sight, issued by a first-class bank
- Or 30% T/T deposit + 70% against B/L copy (for trusted repeat customers)

**For sample orders:**
- PayPal or Western Union (full payment in advance)

We understand that different buyers have different preferences. However, we are unable to accept D/A or O/A terms at this stage, as we are a manufacturer with significant material and production costs to cover upfront.

If you have any concerns about payment security, we can provide our company registration documents, factory photos, and references from existing customers.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
templates.cn: 付款方式分三档说明：标准单（30%定金+70%发货前）、大单（L/C或老客户见提单副本）、样品单（PayPal）。明确拒绝D/A和O/A，但语气要委婉——说'我们是工厂，前期材料和生产成本大'。最后给客户安全感：提供公司注册文件、工厂照片、老客户推荐。
templates.tips: 新客户第一次合作一定要30%定金！不要因为客户说'我们是大公司'就放松。教玩具定制项目如果客户取消，材料和人工成本全亏。见提单副本付款（against B/L copy）只给信任的老客户，因为客户可以凭副本提货（某些国家），然后不付款。

templates.title: 交期说明
templates.scenario: 客户问交期，或者客户要求的交期太紧。
templates.subject: Re: Lead Time for Your Order
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for your question about lead time. Here is our standard production schedule:

**Standard furniture (tables, chairs, beds, cabinets):**
- 20-25 working days after deposit receipt
- For orders over 1x40HQ: 30-35 working days

**Custom outdoor playground equipment:**
- 5 working days for 3D rendering (with up to 3 revision rounds)
- 30-40 working days for production after design confirmation
- Total: approximately 45-55 working days from order confirmation

**Shipping time (additional):**
- To Europe: 25-35 days by sea
- To Middle East: 15-20 days by sea
- To Southeast Asia: 7-12 days by sea

If you have a specific deadline (e.g. school opening in September), please let me know as early as possible. We can:
1. Prioritize your order in our production schedule
2. Suggest splitting the shipment (air freight for urgent items, sea for the rest)
3. Recommend in-stock models that can ship immediately

Could you tell me your target delivery date? I can check if it is feasible.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 交期分三类说明：标准家具（20-25天）、定制户外设备（5天3D+30-40天生产=45-55天）、海运时间（另算）。如果客户有截止日期（如9月开学），给3个解决方案：优先排产、分批运输（急件空运+其余海运）、推荐现货型号。最后反问客户目标日期，确认可行性。
templates.tips: 交期一定要写'working days after deposit'（定金后工作日），不要写自然日，因为工厂周末不生产。定制户外设备的3D设计时间要单独列出来，因为客户可能不知道设计也需要时间。开学季（7-8月）是旺季，交期会延长，要提前提醒客户。

templates.title: 定制需求确认
templates.scenario: 客户要做非标定制（如定制户外游乐设施、定制功能教室布局）。
templates.subject: Re: Custom Design for Your Kindergarten Playground
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for your interest in our custom design service! We specialize in creating unique playgrounds and learning environments tailored to each site.

To prepare an accurate 3D design proposal, could you provide the following information:

1. **Site details**: Site dimensions (length x width), photos of the area, and any site constraints (trees, slopes, buildings)
2. **Age group**: What is the age range of the children? (0-3 / 3-6 / mixed)
3. **Budget range**: What is your approximate budget for this project? (This helps us recommend the right scale and materials)
4. **Theme preference**: Do you have a preferred theme? (e.g. Forest Adventure / Fairy Tale / Treehouse / Ocean)
5. **Brand colors**: Do you need us to match your kindergarten's brand colors?

**Our custom design process:**
- Step 1: You send site info (above)
- Step 2: We deliver a 3D rendering within 5 working days
- Step 3: Up to 3 revision rounds based on your feedback
- Step 4: Design confirmation + detailed quotation
- Step 5: Production + shipping + installation guidance

Once we receive your site information, I will assign a dedicated designer to your project and we can get started right away.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 定制需求确认是教玩具外贸的核心环节。用5个问题收集设计输入：场地细节（尺寸+照片+限制）、年龄段、预算、主题偏好、品牌色。然后清晰列出5步定制流程（5天出3D+3轮修改+确认报价+生产+安装）。最后说收到信息后指派专属设计师。
templates.tips: 预算是最关键的信息！客户往往不愿意说预算，但没有预算做出来的方案可能完全不在客户承受范围内。可以委婉地说'This helps us recommend the right scale and materials'。场地照片非常重要，有树木或坡度的场地反而是设计亮点（可以做树屋、多层结构）。

templates.title: 跟进邮件（报价后没回复）
templates.scenario: 给客户发了报价后，客户3-5天没回复，发跟进邮件。
templates.subject: Following up on our quotation for kindergarten furniture
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

I hope you are doing well. I am following up on the quotation I sent you on [date] for the kindergarten furniture.

I understand you may be busy or comparing options, so I just wanted to check in and see if you have any questions or need any further information.

A few things that might be helpful:
- I have attached our company profile and some reference project photos for your review
- If the price is above your budget, please let me know your target price and I can check if we can adjust the specifications or quantity to meet it
- If you need any additional products (e.g. outdoor playground, functional room furniture), we can combine everything into one container to save on shipping

Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions. I am happy to help.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 报价后跟进不要催得太急（3-5天后再跟），也不要只说'你看了报价吗'。给客户3个有价值的信息：附公司简介和参考项目、如果价格超预算可以谈目标价、可以加产品拼柜省运费。语气要轻松，给客户台阶下。
templates.tips: 跟进邮件不要只发一封就放弃。行业数据显示，80%的订单需要5-12次跟进。可以每隔3-5天跟一次，每次换不同的角度（第一次问问题、第二次发案例、第三次发新品、第四次节日问候）。不要每次都问'你决定了吗'，那样会让客户反感。

templates.title: 催定金/催尾款
templates.scenario: 客户确认了PI但迟迟不付定金，或者生产完了客户不付尾款。
templates.subject: Reminder: Deposit payment for PI No. [Number] — [Product Name]
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

I hope you are having a good week. I am writing to gently remind you about the deposit payment for PI No. [Number], which we confirmed on [date].

As mentioned, we need the 30% deposit (USD [Amount]) to confirm the order and reserve the production slot. Once we receive the deposit, we will start production immediately and the lead time will be [X] working days.

**Important note about timing:**
We are currently entering our peak production season (before school opening), so production slots are filling up quickly. To ensure your order can be completed before [deadline], we would need to receive the deposit by [date].

If you have already made the payment, please ignore this email and send me the bank slip so I can confirm with our finance team.

If there is any issue with the payment, please let me know and we can discuss alternatives.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 催款邮件要委婉但有紧迫感。先说'gentle reminder'，然后说明为什么需要定金（确认订单+预留产能）。加一个时间紧迫感：现在是旺季，产能紧张，要在某日期前收到定金才能保证交期。最后给客户台阶：如果已经付了请发水单，如果有问题可以讨论。
templates.tips: 催定金时，'产能紧张'是最好的理由，比'我们需要钱'听起来专业得多。开学季（6-8月）确实是教玩具行业的旺季，可以利用这个真实的时间压力。催尾款时，可以发生产完成的照片/视频，让客户看到货已经做好了，不付款就不能发货。永远不要说'你为什么还不付款'，要说'我确认一下是否有什么问题'。

templates.title: 售后/投诉处理
templates.scenario: 客户收到货后发现问题（损坏、缺件、质量问题），来投诉。
templates.subject: Re: Issue with your order — Let us resolve this for you
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

Thank you for letting us know about the issue with your order. I am sorry to hear that you experienced [problem — e.g. some damaged items / missing parts].

Please be assured that we take quality issues very seriously and we will resolve this for you.

To help us investigate and resolve this quickly, could you please provide:
1. Photos or videos of the damaged/defective items
2. The carton numbers (from the packing list) of the affected items
3. Your preferred solution: replacement / refund / discount on next order

**Our standard after-sales policy:**
- For damaged items caused by shipping: we will file a claim with the shipping company and send replacements
- For manufacturing defects: we will send replacement parts free of charge (via express for small parts, or included in your next order for large items)
- For missing parts: we will verify against the packing list and send the missing items immediately

Once I receive the photos and details, I will escalate this to our production manager and get back to you with a solution within 24 hours.

Again, I apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
templates.cn: 售后投诉处理的关键是：先道歉+表态（我们重视质量问题，会解决），然后要3样东西（照片/视频、箱号、客户期望的解决方案），然后说明售后政策（运输损坏找船公司、制造缺陷免费补发、缺件立即补发），最后承诺24小时内给方案。
templates.tips: 客户投诉时，第一反应永远是道歉+解决，不要先辩解（'这不是我们的问题，是运输的问题'）。即使确实是运输损坏，也要先帮客户解决，然后再找船公司索赔。照片和箱号是必须的，没有照片无法确认责任。教玩具的售后大多是小零件缺失或运输磕碰，补发小零件成本不高，但能换来客户信任和返单。

templates.title: 节日问候/长期维护
templates.scenario: 节日（圣诞、新年、客户国家重要节日）给老客户发问候，维护关系。
templates.subject: Merry Christmas & Happy New Year, [Client Name]! 🎄
templates.body:
Hi [Client Name],

As the year comes to an end, I wanted to take a moment to wish you and your family a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

Thank you for your trust and partnership this year. It has been a pleasure working with you on [reference a specific project or order].

Looking ahead to next year, we have some exciting new products coming out, including:
- [New product 1, e.g. new eco-friendly refillable marker line]
- [New product 2, e.g. updated outdoor playground designs]
- [New product 3, e.g. new sensory play equipment]

I would love to share more details with you in the new year. If you have any projects planned for [year], please let me know and I can prepare early quotations for you.

Wishing you a joyful holiday season and a prosperous new year!

Warm regards,
[Your Name]
[Company Name]
templates.cn: 节日问候不要只发'Merry Christmas'，要加3个有价值的内容：感谢今年的合作（提具体项目）、预告明年新品（给客户期待）、询问明年项目计划（创造商机）。语气要温暖，不要太商业化。
templates.tips: 节日问候是维护老客户的最好时机，成本低但效果好。要记住客户国家的重要节日（不只是圣诞，还有开斋节、排灯节、农历新年等）。问候邮件里提具体项目（'感谢您今年的XX幼儿园项目'）会让客户觉得你真的在乎，而不是群发。预告新品能创造明年的商机，老客户的返单比开发新客户容易10倍。
